diseases.name: Influenza (Flu)
diseases.description: A contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses, usually with sudden onset.
icd11_titles: Influenza due to identified seasonal influenza virus
diseases.icd11_title: Influenza due to identified seasonal influenza virus
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Common Cold
diseases.description: A mild viral infection of the nose and throat.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: COVID-19
diseases.description: A respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, ranging from mild to severe.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Pneumonia
diseases.description: An infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Asthma
diseases.description: A chronic condition in which the airways narrow and swell, making breathing difficult at times.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
diseases.description: A long-term lung disease that makes it hard to breathe, most often linked to smoking.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Acute Bronchitis (Chest Cold)
diseases.description: Inflammation of the airways in the lungs, usually after a viral infection, causing a lingering cough.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Strep Throat
diseases.description: A bacterial throat infection caused by group A Streptococcus.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Sinusitis (Sinus Infection)
diseases.description: Inflammation of the sinuses, often following a cold, causing facial pressure and congestion.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Allergic Rhinitis (Hay Fever)
diseases.description: An allergic reaction to airborne substances such as pollen, dust mites or pet dander.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Middle Ear Infection (Otitis Media)
diseases.description: An infection of the middle ear, most common in young children.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Conjunctivitis (Pink Eye)
diseases.description: Inflammation of the thin membrane covering the white of the eye and inner eyelid.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Migraine
diseases.description: A primary headache disorder with recurrent, often throbbing headaches that can include nausea and sensitivity to light or sound.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Tension-Type Headache
diseases.description: The most common type of headache, typically felt as a dull pressure or tight band around the head.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Gastritis
diseases.description: Inflammation of the stomach lining.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
diseases.description: A condition in which stomach contents frequently flow back into the esophagus.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Viral Gastroenteritis (Stomach Flu)
diseases.description: Inflammation of the stomach and intestines caused by a virus, leading to diarrhea and vomiting.
icd11_titles: Infectious gastroenteritis or colitis without specification of infectious agent
Gastroenteritis or colitis without specification of origin
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Food Poisoning (Foodborne Illness)
diseases.description: Illness caused by eating food or drinking water contaminated with germs or toxins.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)
diseases.description: A long-term functional disorder causing abdominal pain together with changes in bowel habits.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Appendicitis
diseases.description: Inflammation of the appendix; it is a medical emergency that usually requires surgery.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Hepatitis A
diseases.description: A contagious liver infection caused by the hepatitis A virus, usually spread through contaminated food or water.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Dengue Fever
diseases.description: A mosquito-borne viral infection common in tropical and subtropical regions.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Malaria
diseases.description: A mosquito-borne parasitic disease that can become life-threatening if not treated promptly.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Typhoid Fever
diseases.description: A bacterial infection caused by Salmonella Typhi, spread through contaminated food and water.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Tuberculosis (TB)
diseases.description: A bacterial infection that usually affects the lungs and causes a long-lasting cough.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Infectious Mononucleosis (Mono)
diseases.description: A viral illness, usually caused by Epstein-Barr virus, most common in teens and young adults.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Chickenpox (Varicella)
diseases.description: A highly contagious viral infection causing an itchy, blister-like rash.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Measles
diseases.description: A highly contagious viral disease that starts with fever, cough and red eyes, followed by a rash.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
diseases.description: An infection in any part of the urinary system, most often the bladder.
icd11_titles: Urinary tract infection, site not specified
diseases.icd11_title: Urinary tract infection, site not specified
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Kidney Stones
diseases.description: Hard deposits that form in the kidneys and can cause severe pain as they pass.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Iron-Deficiency Anemia
diseases.description: A condition in which the body lacks enough iron to make adequate healthy red blood cells.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Hypothyroidism (Underactive Thyroid)
diseases.description: A condition in which the thyroid gland does not make enough thyroid hormone.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Type 2 Diabetes
diseases.description: A chronic condition in which the body does not use insulin properly, leading to high blood sugar.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Generalized Anxiety Disorder
diseases.description: Persistent and excessive worry about everyday matters that is hard to control.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus

diseases.name: Depression (Major Depressive Disorder)
diseases.description: A common but serious mood disorder affecting how a person feels, thinks and handles daily activities.
diseases.source: WHO ICD-11 / NLM Clinical Tables / MedlinePlus
